mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2.0% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through lower risk-free rates.
failure_condition: Rank correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window, or average 20-day returns when FEDFUNDS < 2.0% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 220.0 (index 1982-1984=100) signals accelerating inflation, triggering central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 220.0 (as of t-2mo), or rank correlation between CPIAUCSL and 5-day returns is <0.05 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5%) and declining housing starts (HOUST < 900.0) indicate deteriorating labor market and weak consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 5.5% AND HOUST < 900.0 (as of t-1mo and t-2mo)
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5% AND HOUST < 900.0 (as of t-1mo and t-2mo), or rank correlation between interaction signal and 20-day returns is <0.05 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 5.0% defines a recession regime where reduced consumer confidence and corporate earnings drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% (as of t-1mo), or rank correlation between UNRATE and 60-day returns is <0.05 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 900.0 (thousands of units) signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when HOUST < 900.0 (as of t-2mo), or rank correlation between HOUST and 20-day returns is <0.05 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 (index 2017=100) indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate earnings and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when INDPRO < 110.0 (as of t-2mo), or rank correlation between INDPRO and 60-day returns is <0.05 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent housing starts (HOUST < 900.0) and declining residential sales (RSAFS < 375000.0) indicate a collapsing housing market, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced consumer spending.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < 900.0 AND RSAFS < 375000.0 (as of t-2mo and t-1mo)
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when HOUST < 900.0 AND RSAFS < 375000.0 (as of t-2mo and t-1mo), or rank correlation between interaction signal and 20-day returns is <0.05 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP (GDPC1) below 11700.0 (billions of 2017 dollars) as of t-6mo signals recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to economic contraction.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >50% of instances when GDPC1 < 11700.0 (as of t-6mo), or rank correlation between GDPC1 and 5-day returns is <0.05 over 3-year rolling window.
